training_budget_definition: 4 ranks * 16 chronological queries per original memory group * accumulation 1 = global64,55000 optimizer updates
original_action_head: Unmodified action_model/ActionModel and DiT-L:24 layers,1024 hidden width,16 attention heads; original train.py default. Native14D output adapts only action dimensions to RMBench.
model_initialization: Pinned official Qwen visual/text weights and fresh SE/per/cog/DiT-L; no old formal, preflight or performance checkpoint
sampling: Uniform task then uniform complete single-episode group; chronological16 queries with stride4; both Banks reset between groups; incomplete query tails excluded and recorded
checkpoint_policy: Every5000 updates full resumable checkpoint(last2 retained) and inference snapshot; final.pt only after55000 updates
evaluation_gate: Exit0,progress completed at exactly55000,full source/config/normalization/finiteness and4*16*1/global64/DiT-L contracts verified before starting eval_multitask.py
evaluation_protocol: 10 native tasks *50 policy episodes; demo_clean/unseen; candidate seeds100000..102499; nativeexpert checking before policy; successes and failures count without outcome retries; anomalies and incomplete coverage fail explicitly
source_policy: Do not modify original train.py,vla/,prismatic/,action_model/ or reference checkout; required Qwen/native14D adapters stay separate in choice_mem/
safety: Before allocation selectedGPU0-7 utilization<50% and free memory>=35GiB; independent existing environments only; do not stop others; never start duplicate jobs
